column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4 Demon Strait transition recap
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: Having come close to the $$悪魔の海峡$$, said to hold the $$総本山$$, what they saw was...
only an endless expanse of open sea.
As they stood at a loss, an unprecedented earthquake struck them,
and before the party, now unable to move, a mysterious man appeared.
Would this man prove enemy or ally...?
Their journey, too, was finally drawing closer to the overture of the end...
